evidence.note: ReferenceGemm launches ReferenceGemm_kernel<<<grid, block>>>(M, N, K, alpha, A, lda, B, ldb, beta, C, ldc); constraints pin N=1 and leading dimensions to safe fixed values for the current one-dimensional physical launch.
AllocateMatrix allocates sizeof(float) * rows * columns; the override uses bounded M/K and fixed leading dimensions so A/B/C buffers cover all referenced elements.

InitializeMatrix launches InitializeMatrix_kernel<<<grid, block>>>(matrix, rows, columns, seed); constraints pin columns=1 so the current one-dimensional physical launch covers the full logical y extent.
AllocateMatrix allocates sizeof(float) * rows * columns; constraints bind matrix bytes to rows * columns.

kernels.detail: This helper is a collateral kernel from the basic_syrk translation unit; wave2 selected ReferenceSyrk_kernel and nhwc_padding_kernel<float2> as the two new RQ2 targets.

evidence.note: InitializeMatrix launches the double initialization kernel while preparing SYRK operands, but that helper is outside the two-kernel wave2 target scope.
ReferenceSyrk launches a native 16x16 block with N, K, A, lda, C, and ldc passed directly; the reviewed single-block VConfig preserves that 2D coordinate mapping for variable N and K up to 16.
TestCutlassSyrk allocates A with lda rows and K columns and allocates C with ldc rows and N columns; the override sizes both double buffers from those products.
The even-channel float path launches nhwc_padding_kernel<float2> with positive NHW dimensions, halved input/output channel counts, a zero float2 value, and TensorRef-backed input/output buffers.

The host helper requires equal N/H/W extents and input channels not exceeding output channels; the reviewed domains and c_in<=c_out constraint preserve that relationship for the float2 specialization.
The derived variant preserves ReferenceSyrk_kernel's native two-dimensional i/j ownership, lower-triangle predicate, K loop, and alpha/beta epilogue.
The tracked dispatcher selects only the reviewed 8x8, 16x16, and 32x8 template instantiations and fails closed when tile_x does not match blockDim.
The derived variant preserves ReferenceGemm_kernel's native two-dimensional i/j ownership, K loop, and alpha/beta epilogue.
The tracked dispatcher selects only the reviewed 8x8, 16x16, and 32x8 template instantiations and fails closed when tile_x does not match blockDim.
ReferenceTrmm launches ReferenceTrmm_kernel with a native 16x16 block and passes M, N, alpha, A, lda, B, ldb, C, and ldc directly; this fixed geometry is the dispatcher negative control.
TestCutlassTrmm allocates A as lda*M doubles and B/C as ldb*N and ldc*N doubles; the reviewed constraints size all payloads from those products.
The derived variant preserves ReferenceTrmm_kernel's native two-dimensional i/j ownership, M-length K loop, Left-side indexing, and alpha epilogue.
The tracked dispatcher selects only the reviewed 8x8, 16x16, and 32x8 template instantiations and fails closed when tile_x does not match blockDim.
